scripts.build: npm run check:i18n && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.scenes:pack: npm run check:i18n && tsc --noEmit && node --import tsx scripts/package-scenes.ts
scripts.rhythm:build: node --import tsx experiments/my-shot-rhythm/check.ts && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/my-shot-rhythm/tsconfig.json && vite build --config experiments/my-shot-rhythm/vite.config.ts
scripts.editor:build: node --import tsx experiments/rhythm-editor/check.ts && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/rhythm-editor/tsconfig.json && vite build --config experiments/rhythm-editor/vite.config.ts
scripts.editor:pack: npm run editor:build && node --import tsx scripts/package-rhythm-editor.ts
